review_description: When we were getting quotes from Solar companies (4 in all), only Great Souther Solar made an appointment to come and see us. That was within the week, which we thought was great. The 2 people who came, answered our questions from a practical point of view. They were 2 of the people who ended up installing our solar system. The 3 installers and one electrician were very professional and worked hard the whole day. Would recommend this company to everyone. Not the cheapest but the best.Yes to the next question, but only first name please and state. Thanks
The company were extremely good in keeping us in the loop, were ahead of schedule and very professional in their installation. Good solid customer service.

We were contacted out of the blue and although we had thought of getting a solar system we had not done our homework.  It all sounded reasonable and the salesperson seemed knowledgeable.  I then contacts Finn to see what other suppliers there were in our area and we had 2 new quotes done.  The one we selected showed superior knowledge and on the ground experience, backed up by a friend who has used this company and he is very happy with their service- so although they were a little more expensive- we selected them.The other two quotes missed an important element about our 2 phase electricity supply to the shed where we wanted to put the solar panels. This was important as we need 2 inverters.  This was only discovered because he was thorough and opened up our electricity box to investigate- neither of the previous quoters had bothered.  The thoroughness of this investigation and the information and contact provided since has been extremely good. I am very glad we bothered to get additional quotes.

It might seem too fantastic to be true but I could not fault this installer from sales team to installers it was a quality experience. Everything has been done as promised without any prompting from me.Thank you for putting me in contact with such a good supplier installer.Kind regardsNick.
IT IS A 4.6 KW UNIT CONERGY GERMAN PANELS AND KACO 5 KW INVERTER GERMAN  AND IT CHURNS OUT THE POWER
whe were guided though all the paperwork by the company and had good service from our power company (horizon power) so as yet no hassles

Need to do a lot of research to get value for money and also see what suits best on house or shed wherever it is to be installed.When getting quotes make sure you get quotes for the same system.  Sometimes a different inverter can make a difference in performance and cost.
